p0.original: 第十三章 心理障碍的治疗
p0.en: Chapter XIII Treatment of mental disorders

p3.original: 本章视频导读，请扫描二维码观看。
p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 如果你的朋友患有抑郁症，他该接受什么治疗？是药物治疗、心理治疗，还是药物联合心理治疗？除此之外，还有其他有效的治疗方法吗？这些治疗为什么会有效？我们需要找谁以获得这些治疗？针对这一连串的问题，如果我们想要获得可靠的答案，那么接下来这一章的学习就非常有必要。
p4.en: If your friend is depressed, what kind of treatment does he have? Is it medication, psychotherapy, or joint psychotherapy? Is there any other effective treatment? Why are these treatments working? Who do we need to find to get these treatments? In response to this chain of questions, learning in the next chapter is essential if we are to have reliable answers.

p5.original: 在阅读本章内容后，你会站在一个叫德里克的抑郁症患者的视角了解各种与心理障碍的治疗有关的知识。无论接受什么治疗，我们首先需要知道治疗中“治疗同盟”的重要性，其次，我们还需要知道目前能为我们提供帮助的专业人员到底有哪些？各类心理助人者在专业类别和专业技能方面其实差异很大。咨询心理学家（俗称心理医生）和精神病学家（俗称精神科医生）并非一回事，他们的区别到底在哪里？对此本章给出了详细的分类解读。当然，文化也是心理障碍治疗中不可或缺的一个因素。对这些内容的了解，可以帮助你对心理治疗有一个整体性的认识。
p5.en: After reading this chapter, you will learn from a perspective of a depressed person named Derek, about the treatment of mental disorders. Whatever treatment is received, we need to know first of all the importance of the “therapeutic alliance” in treatment, and secondly, what are the professionals who can help us at this time? The types of psychological help vary considerably in terms of professional categories and skills. It is not the same thing to consult psychologists (commonly known as psychologists) and psychiatrists (commonly known as psychiatrists), and what is their difference? A detailed and disaggregated reading of this chapter is given. Culture, of course, is also an indispensable factor in the treatment of mental disorders. Knowledge of these elements can help you to have a holistic view of psychological care.

p6.original: 心理学家怎么治疗心理障碍，对大众来说这一直是件很神秘的事情。本章则通俗易懂地向你呈现了两类主要的心理治疗方式。一类侧重于发展对自身及其问题的理解，叫作领悟疗法，另一类则侧重于通过条件作用来改变行为，叫作行为疗法。进一步而言，本章会对精神分析、来访者中心疗法、认知疗法、团体治疗、行为疗法、理性情绪疗法以及积极心理疗法等主流的心理疗法进行比较系统的介绍。此外，本章还介绍了这些疗法存在的不足，以及证明治疗有效的证据。
p6.en: How psychologists treat mental disorders has been a mystery for the general public. This chapter presents you with two main types of psychotherapy, which are easily understandable. One focuses on developing an understanding of itself and its problems, known as epithetic therapy, and the other focuses on changing behaviour through conditional effects, known as behavioural therapy. Further, the chapter provides a comparative system of psychotherapy for mainstream psychotherapies such as psychoanalysis, visitor centre therapy, cognitive therapy, group therapy, behavioural therapy, rational emotional therapy and active psychotherapy. In addition, the chapter describes the shortcomings of these treatments and evidence of their effectiveness.

p7.original: 除心理疗法外，用生物医学疗法治疗心理障碍的作用机制，将通过药物治疗、外科手术以及物理治疗三种方式呈现给读者。本章的其中一个重点就是帮助读者了解药物在治疗精神障碍中的作用，你会了解到精神科医生常用的药物：抗精神病药物、抗抑郁药物、情绪稳定剂、抗焦虑药物和兴奋剂。这些药物大多会影响神经递质的功能。此外，你还会了解到精神外科和脑物理刺激是怎么治疗心理障碍的。
p7.en: In addition to psychotherapy, the mechanism for treating mental disorders with biomedical therapy will be presented to the reader in three ways: drug therapy, surgery and physiotherapy. One of the priorities of this chapter is to help readers understand the role of drugs in the treatment of mental disorders, and you will learn about medications commonly used by psychiatrists: anti-psychiatrics, antidepressants, emotional stabilizers, anti-anxiety drugs and stimulants. Most of these drugs affect neurotransmitters. In addition, you'll know how psychosurgery and cerebrophysics treat mental disorders.

p8.original: 总体来说，对于如何治疗心理障碍这个话题，并非一个简单的二选一议题。只有在掌握了相应的知识后，我们才有可能做出选择。本章最后呈现给我们一个观点：虽然心理治疗和药物治疗的结合通常比单独使用一种方法的治疗效果更好，但大多数存在非特定“生活问题”的人最好单独接受心理治疗。
p8.en: Overall, the topic of how to treat mental disorders is not a simple alternative. Only with the corresponding knowledge will we be able to make a choice. This chapter concludes with a view that, while the combination of psychotherapy and drug therapy is usually more effective than the treatment of a single method, it is preferable for most people with non-specific “life problems” to receive psychological treatment alone.

p11.en: Derek described his depression to the therapist.
